name: John Zink pressure-assisted flare tips (Kaldair Indair, Kaldair Multipoint Indair KMI, JZ Hydra, JZ Poseidon, KSP)
description: Proprietary high-pressure burner technology; variable slot Coanda flare tip custom designed to enable smokeless flaring using the Coanda effect. No numeric capacity printed on the page read.

specifications.basis: Features: Unlimited Turndown - Some of the systems can offer unlimited turndown, making them highly adaptable to varying operational conditions
Features: No Assist Medium Required - These flares produce short, smokeless flames without the need for an assist medium, allowing for shorter boom lengths and simpler mounting structures
John Zink's pressure-assisted flares have been successfully used in a wide range of applications for over 30 years
